open_points.subject: read_records / ActivationBeforeRun
open_points.text: - read_records: [VALIDATION_ERROR] MUST first raise StoreInternalError, before any record is looked up, when the query's arguments are malformed for its kind (a record_type that has no such identity form, an empty identity list, an empty or repeating statuses of RunsByStatus, or a field of another kind); then raise UnknownReferenceError naming the first missing record, in the order given for identity queries and in the order the relation's fields name them for a relation (an ElementKey names its run); a corpus digest is a value and is never missing, RunsByStatus and AttemptsByStatus name no record, and ActivationBeforeRun finding no activation raises StoreInternalError.
open_points.other_text: - read_records: [RETURN_SHAPE] Returns one RecordSet with each record, exactly as stored, in the field of its type and every other field empty; a relation from an existing record that finds nothing answers an empty RecordSet, never a refusal.
open_points.question: Must ActivationBeforeRun with existing referenced records but no earlier activation raise StoreInternalError, or return an empty RecordSet?

open_points.subject: record_change / ResolveAttemptChange
open_points.text: - record_change: [FIELD_ASSIGNMENT] RecordReadOutcomeChange writes the concluding NodeExecution with its StoredValues and SpooledFiles and no attempt; RecordOperationFailureChange writes one NodeExecution and no attempt; ResolveAttemptChange sets an unknown attempt to the = models.AttemptResolution value; GrantChange writes a StandingGrant with status active; RevokeChange sets an active grant to revoked with revoked_at; RecoverInFlightChange sets one in_flight attempt to unknown with concluded_at, writes its NodeExecution when given and sets used_approval_id's approval to used when given.
open_points.other_text: - EffectAttempt fields (exact, no others exist): run_id: str, node_id: str, map_index: int | None, attempt_number: int, binding_id: str, inputs: tuple[PortRef, ...], idempotency_key: str | None, authority: Authority, status: AttemptStatus, recorded_at: KernelInstant, concluded_at: KernelInstant | None, resolved_by: Actor | None
open_points.question: Must ResolveAttemptChange assign an AttemptResolution value directly, or map it to the corresponding AttemptStatus value required by EffectAttempt.status?
